{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"Catapult API","description":"Your channel's game, bindings and custom bindings, and public per-platform game detail.

## Authentication

The `/api/me` routes take a personal API token, generated from the account settings (or from the keys card on this page). The `/api/games` routes are public and take none.

| Token | Prefix | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| Full | `cat_…` | every `/api/me` route, reads and changes |
| Read-only | `catr_…` | the `/api/me` `GET` routes only |

Send it in the `Authorization` header:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer cat_…" -X DELETE http://localhost/api/me/custom-bindings/active
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer catr_…" http://localhost/api/me/game
```

Where no header can be set (a URL pasted into an OBS browser source, a chat bot), a `GET` takes the read-only token in the query string instead, `?token=catr_…`; the full token is refused there:

```
curl "http://localhost/api/me/game/summary?token=catr_…"
```

Here, **Authorize** keeps a token for **Try it out**: `personalToken` for the header, `readToken` for the query string.
